limitations: All scores are provisional browser assessments based on the attached screenshots and supplied runtime narrative; no runtime checks were independently executed.
A is the mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces; F is the mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility; overall is 0.4A + 0.6F, rounded to one decimal, excluding only null dimensions.
The authorized threshold is not met: multiple screens and components have A or F below 9; strong recovery and state coverage do not erase the remaining composition and clarity issues.
No hard-gate failure is established by this evidence; screenshots clipped at viewport edges do not prove unreachable content, particularly where supplied runtime verifies scrolling and action access.
Transition samples support visual continuity but do not independently establish perceived motion quality; timing, reduced-motion behavior and performance rely on supplied browser evidence.
Physical iPhone, VoiceOver, native text scaling, actual keyboard/speech/haptics, payments and OS sharing remain unverified and are not certified by these scores.
Invalid calendar dates, expanded birthday removal, online Circles, successful physical speech and real payment states are not pictured; their behavior is not inferred.
Synthetic repeated text, historic confidence wording, test-provider labels and layout fixtures are not treated as production-copy defects or evidence of predictive quality.
The sheet letterboxing around constrained viewports is excluded from product-layout assessment.
No novice study or representative physical assistive-technology study is supplied, so exemplary task outcomes and full/native 9–10 certification are not established.
topFixes: Reduce oversized whitespace around enlarged headings and introductions, especially in onboarding, birth details, plans and consent, without reducing the requested text size.
Split the consent disclosure into short, scannable sections while preserving explicit opt-in and separate submission.
Make internally scrolled long inputs visibly scrollable so retained text does not appear truncated.
Standardize secondary-action and input-focus treatments across person, composer and custom-answer screens.
Improve large-text share-preview readability and provide direct access to its text alternative from inspection.
Clarify unavailable-omen recovery and the consequence of Ask again at zero balance.
